description: python_snippet: a script that states its output by writing JSON to standard output has that value taken as the step's output.
notes: The companion to python_snippet.portable_output_is_stdout_json, and the half that vector cannot see. That one asserts the output SHAPE, which an implementation satisfies merely by removing an envelope; this one asserts that a script written the oracle's way runs at all. A harness that binds a result name and treats standard output as logs answers a printing script with nothing, while the shape vector still passes.
